# mtg-mcp

> A C# MCP server that gives LLMs grounded Magic: The Gathering card, deck,
> source, and statistical evidence plus safe deck-planning workflows.

Current code, tests, project files, checked-in configuration, and `AGENTS.md`
are authoritative. This file is a compact orientation index, not a second
instruction file.

## Start Here

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository rules, architecture boundaries, safety, planning, and validation.
- [README](README.md): Installation, configuration, workflows, and public MCP surface.
- [North star](docs/north-star.md): Product mission, evidence hierarchy, and non-goals.
- [Design goals](docs/design-goals.md): Architecture, quality, testing, and MCP principles.
- [Taskfile](Taskfile.yml): Supported local and CI operations; run `task --list`.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Current deck-analysis, simulation, source, and MCP design.
- [Adapters](docs/adapters.md): Provider contracts, auth, caches, pacing, and safety boundaries.
- [Heuristic models](docs/heuristic-models.md): Configurable estimation and non-rules-engine boundaries.
- [Toolsets](docs/toolsets.md): Public tool groups and workflow coverage.
- [Output control](docs/output-control.md): Shared summary, normal, and full result levels.

## Agent Planning

- [Agent workflow](docs/llms/agent-workflow.md): How to inspect, plan, edit, validate, and hand off changes.
- [C# practices](docs/llms/csharp-best-practices.md): Repository-specific C# and .NET conventions.
- [Plans](docs/llms/plans/README.md): Durable ordinary implementation plans.
- [Plan-Led Changes](docs/llms/plcs/README.md): Requirements-backed PLC lifecycle and packet rules.
- [Templates](docs/llms/templates/README.md): Reusable ordinary-plan and multi-file PLC templates.

## Optional

- [Simulation profiles](docs/simulation-profiles.md): Deterministic play-pattern presets and deck intent.
- [Stats Lab metrics](docs/stats-lab-metrics.md): Statistical metric and replay contracts.
- [Observability](docs/observability.md): MCP logs, metrics, and diagnostics.
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): Exercised MCP clients and protocol coverage.
- [Codex playbooks](.codex/README.md): Supplemental review and validation references.
